rows.kind: joint mass, material provenance and force transfer
rows.note: Candidate-multiplier joint sizing is correct, including quadratic mass. At the headline, 44.191468267 kg and 1.258252477 axial/bond multipliers are consequences of equal-stress design, without extra reserve. Legacy Toray supports 1470 MPa but does not establish 1550 kg/m3 composite density. Henkel's 28.9 MPa datum is prepared aluminum, not SiC. Percent-joint cases have unknown capacity; sub-unity Ti cases size below operating demand.
rows.settle: Pin density and laminate/manufacturing specification; verify ceramic adhesion, peel, load spreading, moment transfer and rotational stiffness; include adhesive and attachment mass.

rows.note: The declared 0.6 coefficient and outer-radius gamma convention reproduce. NASA uses a Poisson-dependent coefficient and shell radius. At the fixed headline geometry, an illustrative nu=0.14/mid-radius evaluation gives local SF 1.229307846 rather than 1.258252477. L/midradius is 23.2469. Long curved ceramic shell/column interaction and bending/contact coupling are unqualified.
rows.settle: Declare the material Poisson ratio, shell radius convention and valid coupled instability model; reoptimize only under an assigned model-change card. The diagnostic is not a replacement optimum.

rows.note: The two-way numerical optima use an isotropic global surrogate despite missing in-plane shear stiffness in an unbraced pin grid. Square-cell sag/wavelength sensitivity changes a comparison, but cannot establish missing bracing or joint stiffness.
rows.settle: Specify and count a shear-stable lattice or validate explicitly modeled moment-resisting joints; establish a matching continuum only afterward.

rows.note: Fractional area-based node/member counts and exact residual mass closure are model bookkeeping. rows.settle: Build an integer geometric and installed-mass bill with matched manufacturing evidence; carry all dimensional and flaw tolerances into mechanics.

rows.note: Independent searches recover all 176 reported optima to 1e-6 SF, and eight active-equation Zylon solutions agree. This supplies numerical corroboration of the specified surrogate, not a mathematical global certificate or structural qualification.
rows.settle: Retain best-found terminology; any stronger optimization guarantee requires a separate mathematical bound or certified search.
